docs.title: PGOLD: Press Release
docs.text:
Puregold Full Year 2025 net income jump 8.8% to p 11.3 billion

Manila, Philippines – Grocery retail leader Puregold Price Club, Inc. (PGOLD) grew consolidated revenues to Php 242.45 for 2025, up 10.6% growth from Php 219.17 billion in 2024. For the full year 2025, the enterprise experienced positive same store sales growth (SSSG) of +4.1% from Puregold Stores driven by higher basket size and +6.1% from S&R Warehouse clubs driven by higher traffic. PGOLD consolidated net income for 2025 grew by 8.8% year on year to Php 11.3 billion from Php 10.4 billion in 2024 driven by strong topline growth and complemented by improvement in gross margins. The board of PGOLD has approved a 30% regular dividend payout, equating to Php 1.18 per share, which amounts to a total of Php 3.4 billion. This regular dividend will be distributed to shareholders of record as of April 17, 2026. In addition to the regular dividend, the Board has also approved a 20% special dividend payout, amounting to Php 0.79 per share, for a total of Php 2.27 billion. This special dividend will be distributed to shareholders of record as of August 17, 2026. Together, the total dividend payout—comprising both the regular and special dividends—will amount to Php 5.67 billion up 8.8% compared to last year, reflecting a dividend yield of 4.925%. These payouts will be sourced from PGOLD’s unrestricted retained earnings as of December 31, 2025.“Our record-breaking earnings underscore the resilience of our core businesses with the aim at providing our target customers the best value, even amid challenging market conditions. As we move into 2026, we remain focused on accelerating our store expansion in key provincial markets—broadening our reach, enhancing customer convenience, accessibility, and positioning the company for sustained long-term growth and value creation.” said Puregold Price Club Inc. President Ferdinand Vincent Co. As of end December 2025, PGOLD opened 28 new Puregold stores, 3 S&R Membership Shopping Warehouse and 9 S&R New York Style QSR and acquired 153 Puremart stores. PGOLD operates a total of 784 stores nationwide, comprising 680 Puregold stores, 33 S&R Membership Shopping Warehouses, and 71 S&R New York Style QSRs.

docs.title: DMCI declares P6.4-B special dividend, Consunji says businesses deliver value despite challenges
docs.text:
Tycoon Isidro Consunji-led DMCI Holdings has declared a special cash dividend of P0.48 per share, amounting to P6.4 billion, to be paid on Nov. 21, 2025.
This comes on top of the P0.60 per share distributed earlier this year, bringing total dividends for 2025 to P1.08 per share or P14.3 billion.
Shareholders on record as of Nov. 5 will be entitled to the payout, with the ex-dividend date set for Nov. 4.
“In a challenging environment, our businesses continue to perform and deliver value to our shareholders,” Consunji, the chair and president of DMCI Holdings, said in a statement on Tuesday.
The payout represents 76 percent of the conglomerate’s 2024 core net income and a dividend yield of roughly 10 percent based on its Oct. 20 closing price of P11.20.
